clues.text: Zephaniah said God would destroy Assyria and make this city a dry desert where owls roost on its pillars.
When a prophet warned it would be overturned in forty days, its king left his throne and sat in ashes.
God asked an angry prophet if He should not care for this city of over 120,000 people and many cattle.
Nimrod, the mighty hunter, went from Shinar into Assyria and built this city, along with Calah and Resen.
After the angel of the LORD struck down 185,000 Assyrians, King Sennacherib went back home to this city.
The prophet Nahum said this city had been like a pool of water that was now draining away.
Jesus said the men of this city will condemn His generation at the judgment, because they repented at a prophet's preaching.
